cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

mechanism: A grants a wedding host permission to correct public attribution while requiring acknowledgment of the cook as an expert person.
confusable: High-status self-description alone would not pursue acknowledgment; B must be pressed to recognize A specifically.
comparison: Catering offers a service-based power exchange rather than the bridge ceremony shared civic credit.
seedUse: Use D09-b impersonal buffet credit and pronunciation, with S01 control of the host proposed announcement.
